word:hebrew:H102.explanation: Aggaph means bands—wings of an army or crowds of troops. These bands can be scattered and can fall by the sword.

word:hebrew:H1080.explanation: This Hebrew word means “wear.” It is a verb, so it describes the action of wearing rather than a person, object, or quality. word:hebrew:H209.explanation: Onan is the name of a son of Judah.

word:hebrew:H2104.explanation: Zuzites refers to an aboriginal tribe of Palestine, called the Zuzim.

word:hebrew:H2148.explanation: This Hebrew word is a personal name, rendered “Zechariah.” It identifies several different people in the Old Testament rather than describing an object, action, or quality. word:hebrew:H2236.explanation: This Hebrew verb means “sprinkle” or “sprinkled”: to scatter or distribute a substance in drops. word:hebrew:H3419.explanation: Yaraq means green. It can also refer to a vegetable or herb.

word:hebrew:H5628.explanation: Sarach means to extend or spread. It can also describe exceeding or going beyond.

word:hebrew:H5826.explanation: Azar means to help or aid.

word:hebrew:H6492.explanation: “Pekah” is a personal name, referring to the man identified by that name in the Hebrew Old Testament. word:hebrew:H6643.explanation: Tsᵉbî means splendor, beauty, or glory. It can also refer to a roe.
